name: DuoZuplixo
storyline:
One day, in the early morning, Dr. Zuplow, a short mad scientist who's neither good nor evil, was dreaming up new ways to make himself taller.....
Suddenly, a group of thieves known as the Grabbadosh Gang stormed into Dr. Zuplow's laboratory! Luckily, Zuplow's got just the thing to stop them, a security guard/pet named "Blobguy", or at least, that's what he thought... ....turns out the thieves used an ice blaster to freeze Blobguy! Now the thieves have taken off with Blobguy, so it looks like it's up to Dr. Zuplow and his daughter, Nora, to chase after them and rescue him!
summary: DuoZuplixo is a 2D platforming collect-a-thon with some RPG elements. You'll be taking control of two characters, Dr. Zuplow & Nora. You'll be able to switch between these two on the fly, and will need to make use of both of their abilities to collect all the Zuplonium Orbs and proceed through the areas. Alongside the Zuplonium Orbs you'll also find other secrets hidden throughout, such as Health & Attack Upgrades & tokens that allow you to access 3D bonus levels.​
